utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twentieth, here we go. Can you all hear me on Teams?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, sadly. Already discussing next weekend's plans at ours. Supposed to be barbecue weather, but that was the forecast for yesterday and we got soaked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: British summer, mate. Barbecue under an umbrella, perfectly normal.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the coffee machine in the canteen's still broken. Just a moan, not putting that on anyone's list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Between that and the traffic on the ring road, lovely start. I barely moved for twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we all go home again—finished bits first?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the GT2 yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done, nothing left over from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Nice to have one that's actually closed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the CT1 on Tuesday. Last Tuesday, obviously. Already finished.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Not another inspection for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Blockers haven't shifted: can't get to the Waste Heat Boiler until production gives us a window. That work's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same story on the big boiler. Still waiting on parts, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, both still blocked, not pretending they're available work.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the water booster is cancelled now, production need it running. That's off, not postponed into today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. We're not reopening that shutdown here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While I've got the mic, heard a slight rattle from the wrapper. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Similar from me: heard a slight rattle from the GT1 Compressor Section. Nothing to action yet on that either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observations only. Neither's a new job out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: What about writing up the near miss at the relief valve? That still needs doing, doesn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. I'll write up the near miss at the relief valve by the end of the week. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz. That's the one causing us grief, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, mine. First thing on my list, not something I'm leaving until everything else is done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you grease and check the bearings on the Water Booster Pump tomorrow at 9:30, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just the bearings scope on the Water Booster Pump, yeah? Not taking on that cancelled shutdown as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, just grease and check the bearings. The shutdown remains cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Water Booster Pump tomorrow at 9:30. Got you on the spare-minute priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Han's got the glamorous one, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Oh, absolutely. Living the dream.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you run the monthly fire alarm test tomorrow? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test tomorrow. Fairly important, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there—monthly test?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Monthly test, yes. That's the one Saz just asked for.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's also the toolbox talk for the team. Someone needs to organise it today; it's fairly important. Has that actually got anyone against it?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. I haven't got capacity to take the organising on.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that either. Sorry, talking over you there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No worries. So organising the toolbox talk for the team is needed today, fairly important, but nobody's taken it. It's unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right. Raising the gap, not volunteering myself for it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On my side, I'll replace the seals on the turbine two water valve this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The seals, rather than the whole valve? Sorry, just making sure I heard that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, the seals on the turbine two water valve. I'll do those this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you also take vibration readings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel at half two? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take vibration readings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel at half two. Top priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Does that clash with the seals, or is the afternoon wording loose enough?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: It's fine. The seals are this afternoon; half two is the fixed time for the readings. I can keep both.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, Aisha. The Line 3 Screw and Barrel readings are the top priority of those, please.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I'll schedule downtime for the boiler safety valve with production next Tuesday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the scheduling with production, yeah? Not saying the valve work itself is happening next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll schedule the downtime for the boiler safety valve with production next Tuesday. I'm not promising a work date off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that distinction makes sense. Scheduling, not an agreed outage yet.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on next Tuesday, I'll do a site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor next Tuesday as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Aisha, you're taking the Harbour Road Warehouse site visit with the contractor?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do it. Next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Your calendar's earning its keep, then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: For once it's more than coloured squares. Those two fit, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you send the shift handover report round? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round. Matters but isn't urgent, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Useful having the same report in front of everyone rather than half a conversation.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. And I've heard you on the priority, Saz—no panic attached.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Unlike the coffee situation, which feels very urgent to me personally.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Still not a work order, however emotionally significant.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. Anything in what we've agreed that someone hasn't understood?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No. And the blocked boiler bits are still blocked, just so silence doesn't sound like they've magically cleared.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Only ownership gap we've raised is organising the toolbox talk for the team today. Fairly important, still nobody on it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Agreed. No name against that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.
